keyLimits.en: 0.5 GB RAM, 1x-4x compute; Eco dynos sleep after 30 minutes of inactivity, personal accounts limited to this tier.
0.5 GB RAM, always on (does not sleep).

cautions.en: Cost scales per dyno and per add-on: a real app needs a web dyno plus a database add-on, so the effective monthly floor is above the cheapest single line item.
Eco dynos (the cheapest tier) sleep after 30 minutes of inactivity and are restricted to personal accounts, not a production-ready always-on option.

capabilities.en: Platform-as-a-service that deploys apps via git push or CI/CD without managing servers, using managed containers (dynos).
Fully managed data services: Heroku Postgres, Heroku Key-Value Store (Redis-compatible), and Apache Kafka on Heroku.
Automated application monitoring, threshold alerting and auto-scaling included at no extra cost.
Elements Marketplace offers third-party add-ons for logging, monitoring and extended data storage.
Supports multiple languages natively: Node.js, Ruby, Java, PHP, Python, Go, Scala, Clojure and .NET.

limitations.en: No free tier: the cheapest option (Eco dyno) still costs $5/month and sleeps after 30 minutes of inactivity.
Real projects require stacking multiple paid line items (dyno + Postgres + Redis), so total cost is higher than the headline price of a single dyno.
The newer Kubernetes-powered Fir dynos require a Private Space, adding architectural complexity for full network isolation.

reason.en: Similar deploy-from-git simplicity, but frontend-focused and with a real free tier.
Managed app platform with comparable PaaS ergonomics at generally lower prices.

unknowns: No free tier confirmed anywhere on the pricing page; the exact monthly total for a minimal production app (dyno + database) is not stated as a single figure.
